nodes.label: Conditional liquidation equity and drawdown guard
nodes.rationale: For this earlier $1,000 study, a fixed $100 drawdown from running observed equity peak permanently latches a breach. Fresh delayed bid marks value holdings; invalid/stale/unknown-basis periods remain unknown and block new risk. Gap overshoot and unresolved exits prevent a hard loss guarantee.

nodes.label: Bounded historical and prospective evidence capture
nodes.rationale: Minute coverage preflight, current metadata and a 180-second callback capture have explicit request, record and retained-payload budgets. The capture preserves revisions, timestamps, gaps and hash-chain integrity without interrupting an existing stream. Worker expansion follows measured memory.

nodes.label: Paired simultaneous uncertainty gates
nodes.rationale: Reuse the registered 27 policies with continuous $1,000 account runs. Paired five-session block bootstrap requires complete panels, adequate blocks/activity and nondegenerate variation. The existing two-session validation folds and one active session cannot pass; intervals and selection remain unavailable.
